metadata.Name: STAIR Captions
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese image caption dataset based on images from MS-COCO. It consists of 820,310 Japanese captions for 164,062 images, with five human-annotated captions per image.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the Eleventh International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2018)
metadata.Venue Name: International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation
Affiliations: Software Technology and Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory (STAIR Lab)
metadata.Abstract: In recent years, automatic generation of image descriptions (captions), that is, image captioning , has attracted a great deal of attention. In this paper, we particularly consider generating Japanese captions for images. Since most available caption datasets have been constructed for English language, there are few datasets for Japanese. To tackle this problem, we construct a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset based on images from MS-COCO, which is called STAIR Captions . STAIRCaptions consists of 820,310 Japanese captions for 164,062 images. In the experiment, we show that a neural network trained using STAIR Captions can generate more natural and better Japanese captions, compared to those generated using English-Japanese machine translation after generating English captions.
